title: Customer-Elected Cash in Place of a Replacement — Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
A homeowner who holds a replacement authorization that is neither completed nor reversed may take cash in its place; the settlement is recorded by the customer, carries the settlement basis "customer elected", names the replacement authorization it replaces, and reverses that authorization in full the same day.

## Terms of the election

- **Network installation.** A customer-elected settlement is available only on a replacement that a network contractor can install: when every network contractor of the request's trade whose service ZIP codes include the ZIP code of the covered property is suspended, Bridgewell elects cash itself and the settlement is company-elected.
- **Standing authorization.** A customer-elected cash settlement on a service request is fixed only after a replacement authorization that carries neither a reversal nor a completion report stands on that request. Put the other way round: while the request carries no replacement authorization free of both a reversal and a completion report, no customer-elected cash on that request is fixed.
- **Timing.** For a customer-elected settlement, and only for such a settlement, the cash is fixed and paid on the day the customer elects it, with no cash-in-lieu offer on file; every company-elected settlement remains under the general offer-and-acceptance rule for cash in lieu.
- **Who decides.** Taking the cash is the homeowner's own decision on their Homeowner Service Contracts claim; once it is taken, no unit is installed on that request.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `elect_cash_in_place_of_replacement_7cf483ad`. It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `homeplan_contract_id` | the homeowner service contract number the request is placed under, as the agent reads it from the contract record | identifier |
| `homeplan_service_request_id` | the service request number on which the cash is taken, as the agent reads it from the claim history | identifier |
| `covered_item` | the item settled in cash | one value from the list below |
| `replaced_authorization_number` | the number of the replacement authorization the cash takes the place of, as shown on that authorization in the claim history | identifier |
| `replaced_amount` | the amount recorded on the replacement authorization being reversed | USD, rounded to 2 decimal places, positive |
| `cash_amount` | the cash the homeowner receives | USD, rounded to 2 decimal places, positive |

Values accepted for `covered_item`: `heating_system` (the furnace, boiler or heat pump heating side), `cooling_system` (the central air conditioning), `ductwork` (heating and cooling ducts), `plumbing_leak` (an interior water supply or drain leak), `plumbing_stoppage` (an interior drain stoppage), `water_heater` (the water heater), `electrical` (the interior electrical system), `ceiling_fan` (a ceiling fan), `garbage_disposal` (the garbage disposal), `whirlpool_tub` (the whirlpool bathtub motor and pump), `refrigerator` (the kitchen refrigerator), `oven_range_cooktop` (the oven, range or cooktop), `dishwasher` (the dishwasher), `built_in_microwave` (the built-in microwave), `clothes_washer` (the clothes washer), `clothes_dryer` (the clothes dryer), `garage_door_opener` (the garage door opener).

## Return

One run records the customer's cash settlement on the service request with a cash settlement number and, in the same action, reverses in full the replacement authorization the cash takes the place of. On success it returns `settlement_number` (the cash settlement number issued), `homeplan_service_request_id` (the request settled), `cash_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `settlement_basis` (always `customer_elected`), `reversed_authorization_number` (the replacement authorization reversed), `reversed_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `status`, which reads "paid" when the settlement and its reversal were recorded. The request then shows a customer-elected cash payment and no standing replacement.
